rows.en: Press the Cross button to jump.
Press the Cross button twice quickly and keep holding it to boost downward and lose altitude.
rows.notes: Heard "kakou boost" (processing boost); read as "kakou boost" (descent boost), as in rnk_822.

rows.en: And you can dash even while jumping.
Press down on the analog stick to transform into Battroid mode.
That's the basic Battroid controls. You can't transform out of Battroid mode here, so be careful.
I went out of my way to explain this, so make good use of it. Now train in Battroid mode however you like.
Training ends when you reach the target area or time runs out.
You reached the target area. That's the end of Battroid control training.
Time's up. That's the end of Battroid control training.
I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.
And as always, the controller settings are reset to default during training. Be careful.
Quickly press and release the R button to lock on to an enemy. First, choose your target.
While locked on, quickly press and release the R button again to switch the lock to another enemy.
Lock on while pressing up on the D-pad to switch the lock to enemy warships or enemy aces.
Lock on while pressing down on the D-pad to switch the lock to containers or switches.
Press the L and R buttons together to release the lock-on.
The Square button attacks the locked-on enemy with your main weapon.
The Circle button attacks the locked-on enemy with your special weapon.
If your machine has several special weapons, hold the L button and press Square to switch between them.
Some special weapons are capable of multi-lock-on, locking on to several enemies.
For multi-lock-on, hold the Circle button to lock on to several enemies within range.
If you release the Circle button during multi-lock-on, you attack every enemy locked at that moment with your special weapon.
While the locked-on enemy is in front of you, your lock-on level rises.
Shooting with a raised lock-on level gives bonuses to attack power and accuracy.
The shooting attacks I just explained use the same controls in Fighter, Battroid and GERWALK modes.
That's the basics of shooting attacks.
Training ends when you reach the target area or time runs out.
You reached the target area. That's the end of shooting training.
Time's up. That's the end of shooting training.
I'll explain Special Maneuvers 1.
This line again? Anyway, as always, the controller settings reset to default.
In Fighter mode, hold the R button while locked on to turn so the enemy is in front of you.
In Battroid mode, hold the L button to guard. Guarding reduces damage.
Guarding resets the camera angle to face forward.
While guarding, press up, left or right on the D-pad to move as you guard.
rows.notes: Transcript has a typo kanji ("houkou ki" for "houkou kii", D-pad); meaning clear.

rows.en: You can step and dash while moving in guard too. Your guard drops during that.
In GERWALK mode, hold the L button to hover and stay in place.
While hovering, press left or right on the D-pad to move sideways while still facing forward.
Of course, you can step and dash while moving sideways too.
In Battroid and GERWALK modes, press the Cross button right after taking a down attack to avoid going down.
Even if you go down, mash the Cross button to recover from the down state faster.
When both units are present, you can use tactical commands with the Select button and D-pad combinations.
rows.notes: "Both units" (ryouki) read as both allied units; not confirmed.

rows.en: The tactical command on the D-pad's left orders both units to focus on melee attacks.
The tactical command on the D-pad's right orders both units to focus on shooting attacks.
The tactical command on the D-pad's up orders both units to focus on defense.
The tactical command on the D-pad's down orders both units to perform Special Attacks.
That's the basic Special Maneuvers 1 controls.
You reached the target area. That's the end of Special Maneuvers 1 training.
Time's up. That's the end of Special Maneuvers 1 training.
I'll explain container transport.
Well, as always, the controller settings reset to default.
Lock on to a container and approach it to pick it up.
You can only carry containers in GERWALK or Battroid mode, so be careful.
Press the Square button to put the container down where you are.
And you can't attack while carrying a container, so be careful.
Pick up a container and you might get a special bonus.
That's the explanation of container transport.
Training ends when you bring containers to the designated spot, reach the target area, or time runs out.
All containers have been collected. That's the end of container transport training.
You reached the target area. That's the end of container transport training.
Time's up. That's the end of container transport training.
I'm Sheryl Nome, and...
First, the Real Flight controls.
That's right. It's a bit hard, but master it and you'll fly cooler than ever.
Up on the D-pad pitches down, down on the D-pad pitches up.
Hold the L button and press left or right on the D-pad to yaw.
Press the D-pad up, left or right twice quickly in the same direction to roll that way.
Hold the Triangle button to brake and slow down.
That's the basic Real Flight controls.
In that case, switch to another mode and rest for a bit.
rows.notes: Heard "keitai" (mobile phone); read as "keitai" (form/mode, other kanji).

rows.en: Ranka, what's the next explanation?
Then listen to our explanation!
In Normal Flight Fighter mode, hold the R button while locked on to an enemy to turn so the enemy is in front of you.
Press the Circle and Cross buttons together to spend a set number of blocks and use a Support Skill.
Press the Circle and Cross buttons together to spend a set number of blocks and use a Command Skill.
That's right. You can set me or Ranka as support too.
Then I'll support Alto.
Lock on to both downed units and approach to revive them both.
rows.notes: "Both units" (ryouki) of the downed allies; same reading as rnk_879.

rows.en: That's the new Special Maneuvers and the changed controls.
Pay attention to the new Special Maneuvers too. Being able to lock on to enemy aces right away is a nice feature.
